Record Class OrderResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.order.dto.OrderResponse
Record Components:
orderId - the created order's id
instrumentId - instrument traded, for matching execution history to the catalogue
accountId - owned account, for projecting its simulated positions
status - validation, open, filled, rejected or cancelled lifecycle state
orderType - BUY or SELL
quantity - units requested
indicativePrice - the price the client submitted with the order
bufferPercent - the owner's saved execution buffer snapshotted at acceptance
rejectionReason - rejection or cancellation explanation, or null when none applies
submittedAt - when the order was received
resolvedAt - when the order reached a final status, if it has
simulatedAt - selected replay time, or null when real execution time should be displayed
executionType - Market, Limit, Stop or Stop-Limit condition
limitPrice - immutable limit price for Limit and Stop-Limit orders, otherwise null
stopPrice - immutable activation price for Stop and Stop-Limit orders, otherwise null
referencePrice - authoritative submission quote, null for legacy orders
referenceAt - simulated submission quote position, null for legacy orders
sessionId - immutable simulation session identifier, null for legacy orders
triggeredAt - latched simulated stop activation position
triggerPrice - authoritative activation quote, null before triggering or for legacy orders
evaluatedAt - last successfully evaluated simulated position
reservedCash - cash held for this open BUY order; released on resolution
reservedShares - shares held for this open SELL order; released on resolution
executionPrice - actual fill quote, null before filling
rejectionCode - machine-readable rejection or cancellation reason, or null
public record OrderResponse(Integer orderId, Integer instrumentId, Integer accountId, String status, String orderType, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal indicativePrice, BigDecimal bufferPercent, String rejectionReason, OffsetDateTime submittedAt, OffsetDateTime resolvedAt, OffsetDateTime simulatedAt, String executionType, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, BigDecimal referencePrice, OffsetDateTime referenceAt, Long sessionId, OffsetDateTime triggeredAt, BigDecimal triggerPrice, OffsetDateTime evaluatedAt, BigDecimal reservedCash, BigDecimal reservedShares, BigDecimal executionPrice, String rejectionCode) extends Record
The outcome of a submitted order. status and rejectionReason together answer the second acceptance criterion: whether the trade executed, and if not, why.
